name: Sherle Quisa VomaLockhart
source:
The body always stays in the 11-year-old girl, her real age is not clear. Very capricious, like to choose no place to pamper others, very sticky with male Irell and princesses. Although she always has a look of innocence, in fact, the heart all day long to play their own little calculations. Sherle had a blood brother, and the two siblings went to the Count's house in Fomaluharto with the remarriage of their mother, and the Count's only daughter became Sherle's sister. Having lost her father since childhood, Sherle had an unusual dependence on her brother, and the fact that there was suddenly an older sister made Sherle quite unhappy, and the relationship between the sisters was very tense.
She is very close to Finn because of her age, and she likes scented flowers, and often asks Finn for advice on how to grow flowers, but they seem to die when she tries to raise anything. She can't eat spicy food at all, and because she likes to eat sweets, she always carries preserves with her, so she suffers from tooth decay for a long time.

Translated with DeepL from [url=https://www.baike.com/wikiid/4766777124934008990]baike[/url]
